_meta.doc: Boss Class Ascension tree (proposals/design/boss_class_ascension.md). Cooked from each boss's Legendary Cut: Calling (f20) -> Specialization (f40) -> Mastery (f60) -> Capstone (f80). Phase 1 = the 4 Tier-1 callings. These are small flavor PERKS, not power spikes. Soft-gated (B): a calling is offered only if its requirement is met; Fighter is always available. requirement {type:'any', conditions:[{stat,min}|{knows_any_spell}|{carries_class:[...]}]}. perks: weapon_bonus {groups:[sword|axe|ranged],flat} = small flat dmg with signature weapons; save_bonus {category,amount}; healing_received_pct; mp_cost_reduction; trap_sight (scalars).

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.flavor: You answer the Labyrinth's challenge with steel. The warrior's path.

ability.name: Second Wind
ability.desc: Once per floor: catch your breath and heal 10% of max HP.

mage.name: Mage
mage.flavor: You read the boss's death like a proof. The scholar-wizard's path.

ability.name: Arcane Recovery
ability.desc: Once per floor: draw on the weave and restore 20% of max MP.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.flavor: You took the boss apart by reading its tells. The scout-cutpurse's path.

ability.name: Evasion
ability.desc: Automatically dodge the first trap you trigger each floor.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.flavor: You read the boss's fall as judgment. The crusader-priest's path.

ability.name: Turn Undead
ability.desc: Once per floor: brandish your faith; nearby undead recoil and flee.
